# Líneas informativas (#HELLO, #CFG, #OK, !ERR) para el parser del host (iOS).
# El lado C++ las produce a través de commands.txt; aquí solo se comprueba que están bien formadas.
#HELLO fw=0.6.0 proto=2 role=catcher radio=SX1262 id=C3F01A	{"type":"HELLO","fw":"0.6.0","proto":2,"role":"catcher","radio":"SX1262","id":"C3F01A"}
#CFG freq=915.800 bw=250 sf=10 cr=5	{"type":"CFG","freq":"915.800","bw":"250","sf":10,"cr":5}
#CFG freq=910.525 bw=62.5 sf=7 cr=8	{"type":"CFG","freq":"910.525","bw":"62.5","sf":7,"cr":8}
#OK freq=914.000	{"type":"OK","key":"freq","value":"914.000"}
!ERR syntax	{"type":"ERR","code":"syntax"}
!ERR unknown	{"type":"ERR","code":"unknown"}
!ERR unknown sf	{"type":"ERR","code":"unknown","detail":"sf"}
!ERR range freq 902.000-928.000	{"type":"ERR","code":"range","detail":"freq 902.000-928.000"}
!ERR range meas 16-256	{"type":"ERR","code":"range","detail":"meas 16-256"}
